In the context of the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) reports published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme, **Danmark** (Denmark) serves as the national aggregate level for evaluating clinical quality indicators in acute high-risk abdominal surgery. It functions as the primary benchmark and reference point against which regional and individual hospital performances are measured. The database tracks process and outcome indicators to monitor safety, efficiency, and treatment quality across the Danish healthcare sector.

During the reporting period from September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023, national performance on [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] (antibiotic treatment within three hours) stood at 30.5% [^src1]. This figure saw a modest improvement to 34.4% in the subsequent period from September 1, 2023, to August 31, 2024 [^src6]. Other process indicators revealed significant areas for improvement: only 21.2% of patients with life-threatening conditions like perforation or ischemia were operated on within six hours under the supplementary [[indikator-5x|Indikator 5x]] [^src2], and 19.6% of acute surgical patients received a nutritional assessment within 48 hours under [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] [^src3]. Furthermore, early mobilization within 24 hours post-surgery ([[indikator-6|Indikator 6]]) was achieved for 35.6% of patients nationally [^src7], while postoperative monitoring for at least 24 hours for high-risk patients ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) reached 22.9% [^src11].

Outcome indicators highlight the national mortality rates following acute surgery. The 90-day mortality rate ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]) was 16.6%, corresponding to 529 deaths out of 3,179 treatment courses in the 2023–2024 period [^src8]. For patients with mild to moderate comorbidity, defined as a [[charlson-score-1-2|Charlson Score = 1 or 2]], the 30-day mortality rate was 11.2% (122 out of 1,090 patients) in the 2022–2023 period [^src4], and 12.5% (143 out of 1,144 patients) in the 2023–2024 period [^src9]. Demographically, the national cohort for the 2022–2023 period comprised 3,745 operated patients with a median age of 70.00 years and a mean age of 65.46 years [^src10].

Geographically and administratively, the national data for Danmark is subdivided into five main regions: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src2]. These regions, along with their aggregated totals (e.g., [[hovedstaden-region-i-alt|Hovedstaden Region i alt]] [^src9], [[sjaelland-region-i-alt|Sjælland Region i alt]] [^src9], [[syddanmark-region-i-alt|Syddanmark Region i alt]] [^src9], [[midtjylland-region-i-alt|Midtjylland Region i alt]] [^src9], and [[nordjylland-region-i-alt|Nordjylland Region i alt]] [^src9]), provide the granular data necessary to identify regional variations, allocate resources, and drive targeted quality improvements across the country.

## Claims

**performance**
- For Indikator 1 var den nationale andel i perioden 01.09.2022–31.08.2023 30,5 % (95 % CI: 28,8–32,2) [^src1]

**performance-statistic**
- Nationalt blev 242 ud af 1.141 patienter opereret inden for 6 timer for perforation, iskæmi eller blødning, svarende til en andel på 21,2 % (95 % CI: 18,9–23,7) [^src1]

**statistical**
- Nationalt blev 617 ud af 3.147 akut kirurgiske patienter vurderet for ernæring inden for 48 timer efter operation, svarende til 19,6 % (95 % CI: 18,2–21,0) [^src1]
- I alt 1.133 af de 3.185 opererede patienter i opgørelsesperioden blev mobiliserede indenfor 24 timer efter operation, svarende til at 35,6 % nationalt blev mobiliserede indenfor 24 timer efter operation (95 % CI: 33,9-37,3) [^src1]

**regional-statistic**
- Danmark: 122 / 1.090 døde indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi med Charlson Score = 1 eller 2 (11,2 %; 95 % CI: 9,4-13,2) [^src1]

**performance-result**
- For Indikator 1 var den nationale opfyldelse i perioden 01.09.2023–31.08.2024 34,4 % (95 % CI: 32,7–36,1) [^src1]

**clinical-quality**
- Andelen af patienter med høj mortalitetsrisiko (ASA ≥ 3 eller alder ≥ 75 år), der monitoreres ≥ 24 timer postoperativt på et intermediært eller lignende afsnit, er 22,9 % (95 % CI: 21,1–24,8) [^src1]

**clinical-outcome**
- Nationalt var andelen af patienter, der døde indenfor 90 dage fra operationsdato, 16,6 % (95 % CI: 15,4–18,0) i perioden 01.09.2023 – 31.08.2024 [^src1]
- For Indikator 10 var antallet af døde patienter 529 ud af 3.179 forløb på nationalt plan [^src1]
- Danmark: 143 / 1.144 patienter døde indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi ved Charlson Score = 1 eller 2, svarende til 12,5 % (95 % CI: 10,6-14,6) [^src1]

**demographic**
- For Danmark i perioden 01/09/2022 – 31/08/2023 var antallet af opererede 3.745, medianalderen 70,00 år og gennemsnitsalderen 65,46 år [^src1]
